name: DLCS24
reference_standard: Malignancy assigned to the participant (screening follow-up or pathology)
analysis_unit: Every delivered nodule (all nodules of a participant carry the participant's label)
reference: Wang AJ, Tushar FI, Harowicz MR, et al. The Duke Lung Cancer Screening (DLCS) Dataset: a reference dataset of annotated low-dose screening thoracic CT. Radiol Artif Intell 2025;7(4):e240248.

name: LUNA25-Dev
source: Development set of the LUNA25 challenge, drawn from the National Lung Screening Trial
reference_standard: Challenge-provided malignancy label for each delivered nodule
analysis_unit: Each nodule delivered by the challenge; labels used as supplied
reference: Peeters D, Obreja B, Antonissen N, et al. Benchmarking of AI and radiologists for indeterminate lung nodule malignancy risk estimation at screening CT: the LUNA25 challenge. Radiol Artif Intell 2026;8(5):e260179.

name: LNDb
reference_standard: Mean radiologist malignancy rating of 3 or higher (suspicion)
reference: Pedrosa J, Aresta G, Ferreira C, et al. LNDb: a lung nodule database on computed tomography. arXiv 1911.08434 [preprint]. 2019.

name: LIDC-IDRI
reference_standard: Median radiologist malignancy rating of 3 or higher (suspicion)
reference: Armato SG 3rd, McLennan G, Bidaut L, et al. The Lung Image Database Consortium (LIDC) and Image Database Resource Initiative (IDRI): a completed reference database of lung nodules on CT scans. Med Phys 2011;38(2):915–931.

name: LIDC-path
ct: Diagnostic and screening chest CT (the LIDC-IDRI scans)
reference_standard: Diagnosis from the LIDC-IDRI diagnosis file (biopsy, resection or follow-up); mostly participant level
analysis_unit: Index nodule: largest annotated nodule per CT
reference: Armato SG 3rd, McLennan G, Bidaut L, et al. The Lung Image Database Consortium (LIDC) and Image Database Resource Initiative (IDRI): a completed reference database of lung nodules on CT scans. Med Phys 2011;38(2):915–931.

name: CN-histopath
reference_standard: Histopathology (benign vs malignant; subtype), matched to the nodule
reference: Jian M, Chen H, Zhang Z, et al. A lung nodule dataset with histopathology-based cancer type annotation. Sci Data 2024;11(1):824.

name: CSTLN
reference_standard: Pathology class (benign vs malignant), matched to the nodule
analysis_unit: Every nodule at every time point
reference: Jian M, Zhang H, Shao M, et al. A cross spatio-temporal pathology-based lung nodule dataset. Sci Data 2024;11(1):1007.

name: IMD-CT
reference: Zhao M, Xue G, He B, et al. Integrated multiomics signatures to optimize the accurate diagnosis of lung cancer. Nat Commun 2025;16(1):84.

name: LUNGx
reference: Armato SG 3rd, Drukker K, Li F, et al. LUNGx Challenge for computerized lung nodule classification. J Med Imaging 2016;3(4):044506.

name: NSCLC-Radiomics
reference_standard: Clinical T and N stage, overall stage, histologic subtype, overall survival
reference: Aerts HJWL, Velazquez ER, Leijenaar RTH, et al. Decoding tumour phenotype by noninvasive imaging using a quantitative radiomics approach. Nat Commun 2014;5:4006.

name: NSCLC-Radiogenomics
analysis_unit: Primary tumor located by the provided segmentation
reference: Bakr S, Gevaert O, Echegaray S, et al. A radiogenomic dataset of non–small cell lung cancer. Sci Data 2018;5:180202.

name: Lung-PET-CT-Dx
reference_standard: Histologic subtype coded in the participant identifier
reference: Li P, Wang S, Li T, et al. A large-scale CT and PET/CT dataset for lung cancer diagnosis [Dataset]. The Cancer Imaging Archive 2020. doi:10.7937/TCIA.2020.NNC2-0461.
